title: Fortinet FortiMail: attackers can read or change files
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 37 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. The severity score is critical (9.8).

category.label: VPN, firewall or gateway
category.why: It sits at the edge of your network and faces the internet, so attackers can reach it directly.
category.doThis: If you have it, patch it today. If you cannot, block access to it from the internet until you can.

summary: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 4, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

CISA Vulnrichment marks CVE-2026-104286 as actively exploited
